versions.subject: rule: QBot process creation
versions.detection:
selection1:
    ParentImage: '*\WinRAR.exe'
    Image: '*\wscript.exe'
selection2:
    CommandLine: '* /c ping.exe -n 6 127.0.0.1 & type *'
condition: selection1 or selection2

versions.subject: rule: new Quakbot pattern
versions.detection:
selection1:
    ParentImage: '*\WinRAR.exe'
    Image: '*\wscript.exe'
selection2:
    CommandLine: '* /c ping.exe -n 6 127.0.0.1 & type *'
selection3:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'regsvr32.exe'
        - 'C:\ProgramData'
        - '.tmp'
condition: selection1 or selection2 or selection3
versions.spl: (ParentImage="*\\WinRAR.exe" Image="*\\wscript.exe") OR CommandLine="* /c ping.exe -n 6 127.0.0.1 & type *" OR (CommandLine="*regsvr32.exe*" CommandLine="*C:\\ProgramData*" CommandLine="*.tmp*")
